_about: Noel Sainsbury, American author, for the Word Hoard. Added 2026-11-15 by the non-renewal sweep, batch 10 (Adam 2026-11-03: "I want everything that was not renewed"): the Gutenberg texts of Noel Sainsbury's 1931-1963 books that were never renewed, each checked in NYPL's cce-renewals. No uids minted. Sainsbury (b. 1884) also wrote the Dorothy Dixon books as 'Dorothy Wayne' (Library of Congress and Gutenberg give the pen name his birth year); both are here.

sainsbury-bill-bolton-and-the-winged-car: Bill Bolton and the Winged Cartwheels (1933)
sainsbury-bill-bolton-and-the-flying-fis: Bill Bolton and the Flying Fish (1933)
wayne-dorothy-dixon-and-the-mystery-plan: Dorothy Dixon and the Mystery Plane (1933)

wayne-dorothy-dixon-solves-the-conway-ca: Dorothy Dixon Solves the Conway Case (1933)
